findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 13 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.
Book correction: The book prints "scent line". The correct word is "secant line": the line through the two points (t, s(t)) and (t_{1}, s(t_{1})) of the position graph.
Book correction: The book prints "velocity at x = 3". The variable here is time t, so it should read "velocity at t = 3".
Book correction: Two wording slips in the print: "(Provide the limit exist)" should be "(provided the limit exists)", and "For convenient" should be "For convenience".
Book correction: Small slips in the book's printed solution: "give position function" should be "given position function", and the unit "30 miles/hours" should be "30 miles/hour".
